contracts.preparedAt: after the exact production output plan, immutable facility/crop/item display snapshots, output mass, output fingerprint, and next owner revision are known; before EnsureCommitted mutates output publication
contracts.requiredCall: production-output participant prepares CertifiedSeedCompletionOutcomeReceipt and returns a durable gameplay attachment
contracts.clearGate: input acknowledgement, output acknowledgement, gameplay PublishedAcknowledged, matching result key, outcome ID, and canonical SHA-256 must all hold before orders.Remove
contracts.rollback: output publication and gameplay prepared token cancel together before commit; a committed gameplay result is never rolled back and retains the order for reconciliation

contracts.requiredCall: IOutcomeAwarePhysicalItemBatchDispositionService.TryCommitPending(inputs, Sink, operationId, reasonCode, participant, out receipt, out failure)
contracts.participantCall: participant.TryPrepare(in PhysicalItemBatchDispositionReceipt, expectedOwnerRevision, out prepared, out failure)
contracts.pendingSaveOwner: physical batch disposition row plus EnvironmentalFireSaveData
contracts.clearGate: physical sink pending and fire outcome pending remain until canonical PublishedAcknowledged
contracts.rollback: failed outcome commit restores physical source slices and prevents fire-state insertion; after canonical commit only delivery/ack retry is allowed

contracts.preparedAt: after exact ordered water source slices, water mass, suppression before/after intensities, and facility/actor display snapshots are calculated; before water sink and intensity mutation
contracts.requiredCall: IOutcomeAwarePhysicalItemBatchDispositionService.TryCommitPending(inputs, Sink, operationId, reasonCode, participant, out receipt, out failure)
contracts.participantCall: participant.TryPrepare(in PhysicalItemBatchDispositionReceipt, expectedOwnerRevision, out prepared, out failure)
contracts.clearGate: water acknowledgement and suppression pending clear only after canonical PublishedAcknowledged
contracts.rollback: failed outcome commit restores exact water slices and prior intensity; after canonical commit only delivery/ack retry is allowed

contracts.preparedAt: reserve exact fixed outcome shape before handler; write final exact receipt after deterministic relocation receipt is known and before species state/event publication
contracts.requiredCall: reversible physical relocation participant returning exact ordered source and destination slices plus a durable gameplay attachment
contracts.pendingSaveOwner: physical relocation pending row plus CharacterSpeciesSaveSection
contracts.clearGate: relocation pending and species incident pending clear only after canonical PublishedAcknowledged
contracts.rollback: failed write/commit restores exact source/destination stacks and every captured species/world aggregate; after canonical commit only reconciliation is permitted
